returns.order-not-returnable: This order cannot be returned in its current status.
returns.window-closed: The withdrawal period for this order has ended.
returns.guarantee-ended: The two years of legal guarantee for this order have ended.
returns.line-unknown-product: One of the lines names a product that is not on this order.
returns.line-too-many: One of the lines asks to return more than is left of it.
returns.line-excluded: Some of these goods are excluded from the right of withdrawal.
returns.nothing-returnable: Nothing on this order is left to return.
returns.not-decidable: This return has already been decided.
returns.not-closable: This return has not been received, or it is already closed.
returns.not-cancelable: This return is not an approved one awaiting its goods, so it cannot be canceled.
returns.not-receivable: This return is not awaiting its goods.
returns.cancellation-invalid: A cancellation must name the fulfillment order to cancel, and send no lines — the whole remainder is cancelled.
returns.cancellation-withdrawal-buyer-only: Only the order's own buyer can cancel as a withdrawal; staff cancel with another reason.
returns.nothing-to-cancel: There is nothing left to cancel here. If nothing has shipped yet, cancel the whole order instead.

email.postage-consumer: Returning the goods is at your own cost.
email.postage-shop: We cover the cost of returning the goods.

withdrawal-acknowledged.subject: We received your withdrawal
withdrawal-acknowledged.body: We received your withdrawal from order {{order}} on {{date}} (UTC).

return-requested.subject: We received your return request
return-requested.body: We received your request to return goods from order {{order}} on {{date}} (UTC). We will get back to you.

return-approved.subject: Your return was approved
return-approved.body: Your return for order {{order}} was approved. You can send the goods back now.

return-declined.subject: Your return was declined
return-declined.body: We could not accept your return for order {{order}}. {{reason}}

withdrawal-recorded.subject: We recorded your withdrawal
withdrawal-recorded.body: We recorded your withdrawal from order {{order}}. You told us on {{date}} (UTC), by {{via}}. Our team wrote it down on {{recorded}} (UTC).

return-opened.subject: We opened your return
return-opened.body: Following your request of {{date}} (UTC), we opened a return for order {{order}}. You can send the goods back now.

return-closed.subject: Your return was refunded
return-closed.body: We received your return for order {{order}} and refunded {{amount}}.

return-replaced.subject: Your replacement is on its way
return-replaced.body: We received your faulty item from order {{order}}. We are sending you a replacement; you will get another email when it leaves.

return-repaired.subject: Your item was repaired
return-repaired.body: We received your item from order {{order}} and are repairing it, at no cost to you. Because you chose a repair, your legal guarantee on it is extended by 12 months.

email.remedy-notice: For a faulty or wrong item you can choose a repair, a replacement or your money back. Choosing a repair extends your guarantee by 12 months.

decline-reason.return_period_ended: The period for returning this order has ended.
decline-reason.no_defect_found: We did not find the defect you described.
decline-reason.other: We could not accept it for another reason.

returns.deduction-on-guarantee: A repair, a replacement or a refund for a faulty or wrong item is free of charge: no handling deduction applies.
returns.remedy-invalid: Only a defective or wrong item can be repaired or replaced, and only those returns have a preferred remedy.
returns.deduction-too-high: The handling deduction is more than the refund is worth.
returns.restock-unknown-product: A restock count names a product that is not on this return.
returns.restock-duplicate: A restock count names the same product twice.
returns.restock-too-many: A restock count is more than the line holds.
returns.statement-forbidden: This date or channel cannot be given here: the server sets the buyer's own, and a channel belongs to a withdrawal recorded by staff.
returns.statement-required: A withdrawal recorded for the buyer needs the date they stated it and the channel they used.
returns.statement-future: The date the buyer stated it cannot be in the future.
returns.statement-before-order: The date the buyer stated it cannot be before the order was made.
returns.decline-message-required: Write a message to the buyer: "other" alone does not say why.
